messages:
maria: quick heads-up — saw a throughput regression on A10/T4 runs after yesterday's kernel autotune. p95 latency jumped ~35% for seq>512. Maybe kernel selection picked a kernel that's fast on A100 but terrible on Ampere/GA10x.

chris: are we seeing same on L4? any flamegraphs?

maria: L4 less bad, A10/T4 hit hard. pasted a small perf snippet from profile:
```
seq_len | kernel_selected       | p95_ms
256     | tc_gemm_fp16_tiled    | 24.1
512     | tc_gemm_fp16_tiled    | 38.5
1024    | cu_gemm_mix_fallback  | 84.7  <-- A10/T4 spike
1024    | tensorcore_hybrid     | 29.3  <-- A100/H100
```

ken: sounds like autotuner is favoring a tensorcore-heavy path assuming full tma support. On A10/T4 some microkernels have different occupancy / workspace tradeoffs. Also cudnn workspace growth can evict KV cache pages under memory pressure.

jae: suggested quick mitigation — add device-aware presets, e.g.:
```
presets:
  L4/T4/A10:
    kernel_priority: ["fp16_gemm_small_ws", "streaming_gemm"]
    max_batch_latency_ms: 60
    kv_cache_mode: streaming
  A100/H100:
    kernel_priority: ["tensorcore_hybrid", "tc_gemm_fp16_tiled"]
    max_batch_latency_ms: 30
    kv_cache_mode: direct
```

maria: ^ this looks good. For seq>512 we should prefer streaming KV and lower workspace kernels on L4/T4/A10. Also decrease continuous batching window from 8ms -> 4ms for those devices to avoid oversized batches.

chris: can we get a canary build with these presets + autotuner disabled for device family? push to us-east-2 L4 + eu-west-1 A100 canaries.

maria: creating canary image now. will run 12h perf sweep and attach traces. creating ticket.

perf-bot: created PERF-2025: cross-device kernel fallback tuning for L4/T4/A10 vs A100/H100 (assigned: maria)

ken: follow-up: add an experiment that forces kernel selection per seq bucket (<=256, 257-512, >512) — that's how we avoid single-policy pitfalls.

jae: we should also log kernel_choice metric per request (inc sampling) so we can track distribution and auto-roll back if p95 > target.

maria: agreed. I'll add metrics + canary. tl;dr: device-family presets + seq-length buckets + streaming-kv for smaller GPUs.

chris: awesome. thx, team :thumbsup:
